This chart retains 28 admitted star placements. Tai Yin in Life offers one entry through inward accumulation, reflection and protected reserve; Tian Fu in Siblings introduces the different function of storage, administration and stable capacity. The following chapters select material by domain rather than turning every placement into one personality label.

The twelve palaces form six opposite axes, with triad and adjacent-palace relationships. These are structural coordinates: opposition is not automatically conflict, and a triad is not automatically support. Interpretation requires the relevant functions, conditions and counter-expressions as well.

Read from core orientation and inner experience into work, resources, relationships and support. Long cycles and current timing have their own chapters, followed by navigation. This separates the conditions present in the natal structure from the domains foregrounded at a particular time.
